page.overview:
Who is Innkeeper?

In 171 AG, the innkeeper initially refused to accommodate Team Avatar due to a past incident involving teenagers who ransacked one of her rooms. She admonished the group when Korra and Mako began to use firebending in the premises, urging the group to take the altercation outside. After discovering that Bolin was a mover star, however, the innkeeper retracted her previous decision and offered the group any available room at the inn. When Mako requested the suite directly across from Aiwei's, she remarked that it was too small to accommodate four people, but reluctantly gave the room key to him as he insisted.
